title: Lübeck Altstadt
status: Illustrative pixel-art map from open geodata; 0.4 m tiles, landmarks repainted and reviewed
limitations: Facades have no measured evidence; brick walls and windows are illustrative.
Holstentor, Rathaus, Katharinenkirche, Burgtor and Salzspeicher were repainted individually with a landmark description; their details are illustrative.
Roof colours follow OSM tags; OSM's default copper #33CC99 is shown as patina.
